```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Overview

This example demonstrates SVC, NuSVC, SVR, and NuSVR using the `aoclda` package.

```{r library}
library(aoclda)
```

## Classification Data

```{r cls-data}
X_cls <- matrix(
  c(
    -2.99, -0.15, -0.09, 0.45, -1.03, -0.02, 1.59, 0.34,
    0.04, 2.52, 0.91, 1.12, 0.30, -0.90, 1.88, -0.15
  ),
  nrow = 8, ncol = 2
)
y_cls <- c(0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 1, 1)
```

## SVC

```{r svc}
svc_model <- SVC$new(kernel = "rbf", C = 1.0)
svc_model$fit(X_cls, y_cls)
y_pred_svc <- svc_model$predict(X_cls)
cat(sprintf("SVC predictions: %s\n", paste(y_pred_svc, collapse = " ")))
```

## NuSVC

```{r nusvc}
nusvc_model <- NuSVC$new(nu = 0.5, kernel = "rbf")
nusvc_model$fit(X_cls, y_cls)
y_pred_nusvc <- nusvc_model$predict(X_cls)
cat(sprintf("NuSVC predictions: %s\n", paste(y_pred_nusvc, collapse = " ")))
```

## Regression Data

```{r reg-data}
X_reg <- matrix(
  c(
    -0.46, 0.50, -1.72, 0.07, -0.91, -1.01, 1.58, 1.47,
    -0.47, -0.14, -0.56, -1.42, -1.41, 0.31, 0.77, -0.23
  ),
  nrow = 8, ncol = 2
)
y_reg <- c(-36.2, 27.76, -114.51, -20.17, -79.45, -56.15, 109.22, 85.06)
```

## SVR

```{r svr}
svr_model <- SVR$new(kernel = "rbf", C = 1.0)
svr_model$fit(X_reg, y_reg)
y_pred_svr <- svr_model$predict(X_reg)
cat(sprintf("SVR predictions: %s\n", paste(round(y_pred_svr, 4), collapse = " ")))
```

## NuSVR

```{r nusvr}
nusvr_model <- NuSVR$new(nu = 0.4, kernel = "rbf")
nusvr_model$fit(X_reg, y_reg)
y_pred_nusvr <- nusvr_model$predict(X_reg)
cat(sprintf("NuSVR predictions: %s\n", paste(round(y_pred_nusvr, 4), collapse = " ")))
```
